title: The Flag & the Coat of Arms - A zászló és a címer

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the Hungarian flag's colours (piros, fehér, zöld) and their traditional symbolic meanings.
I can explain the heraldry of the coat of arms: the Árpád stripes (four rivers), the triple mound, and the apostolic double cross.
I can explain the historical importance of the Szent Korona (Holy Crown) and where it is preserved today.
I can explain why the cross on top of the Holy Crown is bent.
I can use -ból/-ből áll and heraldic verbs (szimbolizál, jelképez) to describe composite national symbols.
